Yoruba translation of powpow-register v2.0.1. Agent-assisted Bubble registration onboarding in Yoruba.
Localize display name; align search keywords with per-language translations; add categories

Initial release of powpow-register-yo, a skill for guiding users through registration and activation for PowPow (Bubble):

- Provides step-by-step guidance for new users from product introduction to account activation.
- Helps troubleshoot common registration issues (email/username in use, verification code not received, password issues, activation problems).
- Focuses solely on user guidance with no account creation or automation features.
- Includes instructions and visual walkthroughs—screenshots are provided as external links only.
- Clearly separates registration steps, post-registration activation, and payment guidance.
- Maintains a user-centric conversation flow, always ending with a clear, actionable next step.
